svg.title: Ender westward six-pose staff-continuity artwork — UNAPPROVED
svg.desc: Independent editable vector left profile at 64x96 pixels per frame. Copper auburn hair, green-lensed brass goggles, olive-tan scholar fieldwear, neutral hand, and 81-pixel ferruled back-carried staff fixed to the body center line x31 in all six poses. The original right-facing raster source from PR #308 remains unmodified. This art is proposed, not the creator-accepted side-view master.
